017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.stream;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import java.lang.reflect.*;
023import java.util.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.marshall.serializer.*;
028
029/**
030 * Static factories that produce buffered {@link RecordReader} / {@link RecordWriter} instances for
031 * formats whose token-stream surface is whole-value-only (no native {@link TokenReader} /
032 * {@link TokenWriter}).
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * The cursors are created from the <b>live session</b> ({@link ParserSession} /
036 * {@link SerializerSession}), so they honor the same per-invocation configuration (swaps, bean
037 * filters, locale/timezone, schema) as {@code parse(...)}/{@code serialize(...)}.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * Reduces per-format override boilerplate to a one-liner on the session class:
041 * <p class='bjava'>
042 *    <ja>@Override</ja>
043 *    <jk>public</jk> RecordReader readRecords(Object <jv>input</jv>) <jk>throws</jk> IOException {
044 *       <jk>return</jk> RecordAdapter.<jsm>reader</jsm>(<jk>this</jk>, <jv>input</jv>);
045 *    }
046 *
047 *    <ja>@Override</ja>
048 *    <jk>public</jk> RecordWriter writeRecords(Object <jv>output</jv>) <jk>throws</jk> IOException {
049 *       <jk>return</jk> RecordAdapter.<jsm>writer</jsm>(<jk>this</jk>, <jv>output</jv>);
050 *    }
051 * </p>
052 *
053 * <p>
054 * All four cursors report {@link RecordReader#isStreaming() isStreaming()} == <jk>false</jk> (they
055 * buffer) and obey one resource-ownership rule: {@link Closeable#close() close()} closes the
056 * input/output it was handed when it is {@link Closeable}.  Multi-rooted formats that need
057 * different semantics (jsonl, csv, sse) implement their own cursor.
058 */
059@SuppressWarnings({
060   "resource" // RecordReader/RecordWriter returned here are Closeables owned by the caller; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
061})
062public final class RecordAdapter {
063
064   private RecordAdapter() {
065      // Static-method facade.
066   }
067
068   /** Closes the handed input/output when it is {@link Closeable} (shared resource-ownership rule). */
069   private static void closeIfCloseable(Object io) throws IOException {
070      if (io instanceof Closeable io2)
071         io2.close();
072   }
073
074   /**
075    * Creates a single-shot {@link RecordReader} that delegates {@code read(...)} calls to the
076    * session's {@link ParserSession#read(Object, Class) read(...)} entry point.
077    *
078    * @param session The format's live parser session.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
079    * @param input The input to bind on the first {@code read(...)} call.
080    * @return A new {@link RecordReader}.
081    */
082   public static RecordReader reader(ParserSession session, Object input) {
083      return new RecordReader() {
084         private boolean exhausted;
085
086         @Override public boolean canRead() {
087            return !exhausted;
088         }
089
090         @Override public <T> T read(Class<T> type) throws IOException, ParseException {
091            checkNotExhausted();
092            exhausted = true;
093            return session.read(input, type);
094         }
095
096         @Override public <T> T read(ClassMeta<T> type) throws IOException, ParseException {
097            checkNotExhausted();
098            exhausted = true;
099            return session.read(input, type);
100         }
101
102         @Override public <T> T read(Type type, Type... args) throws IOException, ParseException {
103            checkNotExhausted();
104            exhausted = true;
105            return session.read(input, type, args);
106         }
107
108         @Override public boolean isStreaming() {
109            return false;
110         }
111
112         @Override public void close() throws IOException {
113            exhausted = true;
114            closeIfCloseable(input);
115         }
116
117         private void checkNotExhausted() {
118            if (exhausted)
119               throw new IllegalStateException("Cursor has already produced its single root value.");
120         }
121      };
122   }
123
124   /**
125    * Creates an array-element {@link RecordReader} backed by a buffered list parse.
126    *
127    * <p>
128    * Equivalent to calling {@code session.read(input, List.class, Object.class)} once and
129    * iterating the result.  This is correct but NOT streaming &mdash; the whole array is
130    * materialized.  Format-specific implementations may override
131    * {@link ArrayRecordReadable#readArrayRecords(Object)} directly for actual streaming.
132    *
133    * @param session The format's live parser session.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
134    * @param input The input to bind on the first read.
135    * @return A new {@link RecordReader} that yields one record per array element.
136    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred reading the input.
137    */
138   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
139   public static RecordReader arrayReader(ParserSession session, Object input) throws IOException {
140      List<?> all;
141      try {
142         all = session.read(input, List.class, Object.class);
143      } catch (ParseException e) {
144         throw new IOException(e);
145      }
146      var iter = (all == null ? Collections.<Object>emptyList() : (List<Object>) all).iterator();
147      return new RecordReader() {
148         @Override public boolean canRead() {
149            return iter.hasNext();
150         }
151         @Override public <T> T read(Class<T> type) {
152            return session.convertToType(nextElement(), type);
153         }
154         @Override public <T> T read(ClassMeta<T> type) {
155            return session.convertToType(nextElement(), type);
156         }
157         @Override public <T> T read(Type type, Type... args) {
158            return session.<T>convertToType(nextElement(), type, args);
159         }
160         @Override public boolean isStreaming() {
161            return false;
162         }
163         @Override public void close() throws IOException {
164            closeIfCloseable(input);
165         }
166         private Object nextElement() {
167            if (!iter.hasNext())
168               throw new IllegalStateException("Array stream is exhausted.");
169            return iter.next();
170         }
171      };
172   }
173
174   /**
175    * Creates an array-element {@link RecordWriter} that buffers each {@link RecordWriter#write(Object)
176    * write(...)} call and emits the whole list on {@link RecordWriter#close()}.
177    *
178    * <p>
179    * This is correct but NOT streaming &mdash; the writes are accumulated in memory.
180    * Format-specific implementations may override
181    * {@link ArrayRecordWritable#writeArrayRecords(Object)} directly for actual streaming.
182    *
183    * @param session The format's live serializer session.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
184    * @param output The output to write to.
185    * @return A new {@link RecordWriter} that accepts N elements and emits an N-element array.
186    */
187   public static RecordWriter arrayWriter(SerializerSession session, Object output) {
188      return new RecordWriter() {
189         private final List<Object> buf = l();
190         private boolean closed;
191
192         @Override public RecordWriter write(Object value) {
193            if (closed)
194               throw new IllegalStateException("Array stream is closed.");
195            buf.add(value);
196            return this;
197         }
198         @Override public boolean isStreaming() {
199            return false;
200         }
201         @Override public void flush() throws IOException {
202            if (output instanceof Flushable output2)
203               output2.flush();
204         }
205         @Override public void close() throws IOException {
206            if (closed)
207               return;
208            closed = true;
209            try {
210               session.write(buf, output);
211            } catch (SerializeException e) {
212               throw new IOException(e);
213            }
214            closeIfCloseable(output);
215         }
216      };
217   }
218
219   /**
220    * Creates a single-shot {@link RecordWriter} that delegates {@code write(Object)} calls to the
221    * session's {@link SerializerSession#write(Object, Object) write(...)} entry point.
222    *
223    * @param session The format's live serializer session.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
224    * @param output The output to write to.
225    * @return A new {@link RecordWriter}.
226    */
227   public static RecordWriter writer(SerializerSession session, Object output) {
228      return new RecordWriter() {
229         private boolean written;
230
231         @Override public RecordWriter write(Object value) throws IOException {
232            if (written)
233               throw new IllegalStateException("Cursor has already accepted its single root value.");
234            written = true;
235            try {
236               session.write(value, output);
237            } catch (SerializeException e) {
238               throw new IOException(e);
239            }
240            return this;
241         }
242
243         @Override public boolean isStreaming() {
244            return false;
245         }
246
247         @Override public void flush() throws IOException {
248            if (output instanceof Flushable output2)
249               output2.flush();
250         }
251
252         @Override public void close() throws IOException {
253            closeIfCloseable(output);
254         }
255      };
256   }
257}
